Academic foundation · Primary references

Human-centred design, responsible brand communication and accessible systems

Primary frameworks and standards support the ten executive lessons. They establish design methods, not proof of commercial outcomes or licence to make unsupported brand claims.

ISO 9241-210:2019 · Human-centred designHuman-centred design principles and iterative activities for interactive systems.Open primary reference ↗Design Council · Double DiamondDiscover, Define, Develop and Deliver: question assumptions, iterate and test proposed solutions.Open primary reference ↗Nielsen Norman Group · Ten usability heuristicsFeedback, user control, consistency, recognition, error prevention and interface evaluation.Open primary reference ↗W3C · WCAG 2.2Testable accessibility criteria across perceivable, operable, understandable and robust content.Open primary reference ↗GOV.UK Design SystemReusable patterns, accessible components, typography, forms and service consistency.Open primary reference ↗GOV.UK Service Manual · DesignUser-centred service design, prototyping, inclusive writing and structuring forms.Open primary reference ↗IDEO · Design ThinkingHuman desirability, technical feasibility and business viability; empathy, prototyping and iteration.Open primary reference ↗Strategyzer · Business Model CanvasNine connected building blocks: value proposition, channels, customer relationships and the business model to validate downstream.Open primary reference ↗
02 · Business Process Definition

CEO · Corporate Communication / UX · SIPOC

One creative process · evidence, design decisions and accountable handover.

SuppliersCEO-01 / CEO-02 / CEO-03 / CEO-04

CEO-01 PMO; CEO-02 Reputational Commitment; CEO-03 Affairs & Risk; CEO-04 Strategy Research; CEO-supplied creative resources.

InputsBusiness · Reputation · Risk · Market

Business identity; corporate values; brand requirements; legal and rights restrictions; Buyer Persona; 4P value propositions; prototype references.

ProcessIdentity → Toolkit → Templates → Media

Evidence intake → combined logo + palette → corporate toolkit → mobile-first interface design → five planned photo assets → review and handover.

OutputsBrand system · Prototypes · Asset briefs

Approved logo and three colours; typography and icons; corporate presentation and white-paper templates; HTML UX prototypes; five image briefs/assets; asset register.

CustomersInnovation first · CMO / CEO

Primary: Business Development & Innovation (MVP). Specialists: CMO for brand and content; CEO for approvals. C-Level operational owners downstream.

CEO-05 is accountable for design intent and governed assets, not the operational MVP, live payment integration, deployment or ownership of each C-Level process.

03 · Applied Executive Laboratory

Corporate Communication / UX · Creative Production Lab

Create the brand first; then the corporate toolkit; then experience templates. Define exact media dimensions after validating the interface. Export draft assets and briefs to Business Development & Innovation.

DESIGN FACTORY · Evidence → Corporate Identity → Toolkit → UX Templates → 4P & Corporate Media → Business Development & Innovation. Guided help is available through AI·Link.

The creative workspace runs locally inside this page. Save or export your work before clearing the browser; formal asset rights and final MVP acceptance require separate validation.

METHODOLOGY AT THE END OF THE JOURNEY

DIIIP connects identity evidence to Innovation-ready experiences

Corporate Communication / UX converts upstream evidence and CEO-approved creative choices into reusable assets, mobile-first interface prototypes and traceable delivery specifications.

D
Data

PMO business scope, corporate values, risk constraints, Buyer Persona, 4P evidence, upstream contracts and existing approved assets.

I
Information

Organised brand brief, customer pains/gains, visual rules, interface requirements, planned placements and exact media dimensions.

I
Intelligence

Guided logo/colour design, template planning, experience architecture, prompt construction, user-centred review and accessibility checks.

I
Insights

Selected brand identity, coherent templates, validated design decisions, interaction prototypes, media evidence and unresolved production gaps.

P
C-Level Destiny

Primary governed handover: Business Development & Innovation. Brand/content to CMO and identity approval to CEO; later operational transfer to C-Level owners.
